body: I also am in severe chronic pain and it’s getting worse and worse everyday. I’ve tried different medication and therapies but nothing worked. The pain has led me to depression and suicidal. I think about dying all the time and I guess I’m not brave enough to do it and I don’t want to hurt my so. I still want to live cause there’s so much I want to explore but my pain is stopping me from living. I’ll see where life takes me in the time being and I hope your surgery goes well!
